data.title: Dubai Harbour Residences
data.about:
Discover the luxury of Dubai Harbour Residences by H&H Development and Shamal Holding. This stunning collection of beachfront homes, designed by the acclaimed Nikken Sekkei, offers the perfect blend of elegance and livability. These residences are crafted for hosting, celebrating, and relaxing, with breathtaking views in every direction.

Choose from 343 units and two penthouses at Dubai Harbour Residences, featuring 1 to 4-bedroom apartments. Each home showcases a nautical color palette of deep blues and crisp whites, with impeccable textures and finishes. Flooded with natural light, these residences offer panoramic sea views of Palm Jumeirah and city views. Check out the floor plans of Dubai Harbour Residences to find your dream home.

At Dubai Harbour Residences by Shamal Holding, you're investing in a lifestyle. With flexible payment plans and a prime location, now is the perfect time to explore property for sale at Dubai Harbour Residences. Don't miss out on this unique opportunity to own a piece of paradise.

characteristics_module.title: Luxury Beachfront Living at Dubai Harbour Residences.
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Refined collection of seafront homes at Dubai Harbour Residences, crafted for superior liveability.
  • Prime location in Dubai Harbour, offering unrivalled proximity to marinas, a private beach, retail, and leisure facilities.
  • Excellent connectivity to Dubai's center, just moments away, with the new bridge reducing travel time from Sheikh Zayed Road to Dubai Harbour from 12 to 3 minutes.
  • Generous layouts, high ceilings, and large terraces designed for year-round enjoyment.
  • Thoughtful suite of amenities for congregation, celebration, and contemplation, enhancing the coastal living experience.
  • Rooted in luxury hospitality, Dubai Harbour Residences invites residents to thrive in an effortless existence.
  • Immerse yourself in the rich culture and dynamic rhythms of Dubai at Dubai Harbour Residences by Shamal.

location_tile.title: The Most Spectacular Location in Dubai Harbour.
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Discover Dubai Harbour Residences, offering a unique blend of beachfront living and city convenience. Situated in Dubai Harbour, residents enjoy unparalleled access to the beach while being surrounded by urban amenities. Live amidst refined leisure spots, a vibrant marina, and the beautiful Arabian Gulf. The area boasts a central boulevard, waterfront promenades, and Dubai Harbour's renowned leisure attractions, creating an unmatched destination.

Life at Dubai Harbour Residences embodies the freedom of the open seas and the charm of marina living. Residents start their day with sunrise walks on sandy shores, indulge in ocean adventures, and host social gatherings in the gentle sea breeze. With award-winning marinas, a private beach, and direct access to Sheikh Zayed Road, you'll experience a wealth of remarkable moments on land and at sea.

  • 10 Mins to Dubai Marina Mall 
  • 10 Mins to Palm Jumeirah
